subject: catalog-cleanup
title: Two stores, one catalog check: how the pilot works
description:
What you send and what you get back: the two-store catalog cleanup pilot for e-commerce sellers.

Product Catalog Cleanup and Cross-Store Check: a pilot offer from Amber One. The sample uses an invented business and invented data. A person reviews every report before it goes to you. Narrated with a synthetic voice.

#ecommerce #marketplace

See the sample report and the pilot terms: https://hq.amberoneai.com/offers/catalog-cleanup?src=youtube&utm_campaign=catalog-cleanup-how-it-works
narration: How the two-store catalog cleanup pilot works.
You send a product export from each store. Your online store is the source of truth.
You get missing fields, failed barcodes, duplicate SKUs, price and stock differences, and a proposed-changes sheet.
No store login is needed, and nothing in your stores is changed.
Up to 1,000 SKUs across two stores, one report. The price and terms are on the page.
